Make nights brighter with Galaxy S26 Ultra's Nightography Video. Every detail stays bright and crystal clear, even in the dark. Wider apertures for 47 % improved brightness on the 200 MP Wide camera plus noise reduction delivers clear and detailed videos even in low-light environments. Learn more: http://smsng.co/S26Ultra_Nightography-Video_yt

Q: Is Galaxy S26 Ultra good for taking videos at night?
A: Galaxy S26 Ultra is equipped with a powerful camera system that combines improved hardware with intelligent software making it good for taking videos at night. The 200 MP Wide camera now has wider apertures that let in more light thanks to the lens now opening to F1.4. This results in 47 % improved brightness. And the 50 MP Telephoto camera also has improved f-stops for 37 % improved brightness even at full 5x optical zoom. Powered by the powerful processor, Nightography Video then provides noise reduction to further enhance the color and details in videos that are shot in low light.
